title: Portrait 9:16
script: Portrait mode is perfect for TikTok and Reels. [Visual: phone screen]\nThe 9:16 aspect ratio fills the entire screen. [Visual: vertical video]\nThis format gets the most engagement on mobile. [Visual: mobile user]

title: Landscape 16:9
script: Landscape mode is the classic YouTube format. [Visual: wide screen]\nThe 16:9 aspect ratio gives you cinematic feel. [Visual: cinema wide]\nPerfect for tutorials and long-form content. [Visual: youtube player]

title: Square 1:1
script: Square mode is perfect for Instagram feed posts. [Visual: instagram app]\nThe 1:1 aspect ratio looks great in grids. [Visual: photo grid]\nIt also works well for Facebook and LinkedIn. [Visual: social icons]
